stations.title: Station 1: Turtle Geometry & Maze Navigation
stations.desc: An excellent graphical library in Python for representing coordinates, movement of software objects, and drawing geometric shapes.
stations.story:
👋 Welcome, future coding hero!

Let's dive into our interactive session for Turtle Geometry & Maze Navigation!

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:
  • 🐢 Python drawing library (Turtle): An excellent graphical library in Python for representing coordinates, movement of software objects, and drawing geometric shapes.

💻 Starter Code Block - Drawing spirals and calculating the factorial (Factorial):

    if n == 0:
        return 1
    return n * factorial(n - 1)

stations.title: Station 11: Validation & Exception Handling

stations.story:

Let's dive into our interactive session for Validation & Exception Handling!

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:

  • ⚠️ Verify that integers are entered: Forcing the user to enter integer and positive numbers and repeat the question until the entered data matches 100%.

💻 Starter Code Block - Verify that integers are entered:

        num = int(input("Enter positive number: "))
        if num > 0: break

        print("Please type only numbers!")
